description: This file defines the BillingPeriodService class, which manages billing period data, synchronization with Stripe subscriptions, and billing logic for teams and organizations within the application.

classes.name: BillingPeriodService
classes.description: Service class for managing billing periods, syncing with Stripe, and providing billing info for teams and organizations.

methods.name: isAnnualPlan
methods.description: Checks if the team's billing period is annually.

methods.name: isInTrialPeriod
methods.description: Determines if the team is currently in a trial period.

methods.name: shouldApplyMonthlyProration
methods.description: Decides if monthly proration should be applied based on feature flag and billing info.

methods.name: shouldApplyHighWaterMark
methods.description: Decides if high water mark seating feature should be applied based on feature flag and billing info.

methods.name: isMonthlyBilling
methods.description: Checks if the team's billing period is monthly.

methods.name: getOrCreateBillingPeriodInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates billing period info, including syncing with Stripe if needed.

methods.name: getBillingPeriodInfo
methods.description: Returns billing period info for a team.

methods.name: updateBillingPeriod
methods.description: Updates billing period and price per seat for a team or organization.
